Danish Social Liberal Party | The Danish Social Liberal Party (Danish: "Radikale Venstre" , "Radical Left", i.e. "Radical Liberal Party") is a social-liberal political party in Denmark.  The party is a member of Liberal International and the Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe (ALDE).
